scope: L2-A only; no automatic L2-B, online release, n-step, tau/reward/architecture change or periodic connection resets
BN: Evolves as historical H1; not described as a completely frozen policy
required_implementation_checks: Frozen actor trainable/Adam variables verified; actual separate update counters in CSV
Stop optimizer exactly at50k or first S1-S3; preserve first-stop model, then drain data without more optimization and log unused credit
Snapshot update-map from actual counters; not checkpoint experience number
Record latent random offset and clipping flags for E1; cumulative executed action alone cannot guarantee innovation identification after clipping
Use isolated framework/native paths; source and51 model integrity, IPC ownership, sysctl restoration and deadlines verified

statistics.primary: Pre-fixed J10 andJ40 cumulative innovation responses for all RTT x pre-action delay classes, report raw and multiplicity-aware uncertainty; no maximum-z selection
statistics.secondary: Poisson-weighted persistent summaries are exploratory, not identified Q labels
statistics.critic: Snapshot queries and paired terminal-replay full/R100-only/R200-only critic diagnostics; label finite off-policy reuse and sampler repeats

safety: Historical S1-S3 plus finite wall/update caps and policy-at-first-stop. BN evolution requires a short admission check. No silent retry after unsafe stop.
analysis_budget: Three40k-update offline critic arms x two sampler repeats is about30min learner compute at observed throughput, not a few minutes. Retain NOT_RUN for work exceeding budget.
resume: No continuous TCP/RNG/queue resume. L2-B would require a separately validated restart or explicit staged controller and separate authorization.
